tables.title: The originals' own step: numpy 2.3.5 / SciPy 1.15.3 → numpy 2.5.4 / SciPy 1.18.1
tables.note: The records' step (python_versions): each comparison of a library script whose originals' outputs are digested, in the shared releases (two runs: none varies) and in the newest. Every change has a known reason, LARMORX following each release: LAPACK-3.12.1: numpy's OpenBLAS 0.3.31 and later bundle LAPACK 3.12.1, whose DLARF1F (dorm2r, dorml2, dgebd2) moves the last bits of numpy.linalg.svd and eigh, so nibabel 5.4.2 writes other NIfTI quaternions (quatern_b, c, d) for some oblique affines (every other byte identical; SCIPY-1.18-INV: SciPy 1.18 rewrote scipy.linalg.inv; NUMPY-2.5-PERCENTILE-RANGE: numpy 2.5 checks percentile's q against [0, 100] before dividing it by 100; SCIPY-1.16-ROW-ORDER: SciPy 1.16 onwards sorts every row of a sparse matrix built through COO (1.15 stored the Laplacian's diagonal after each row's other entries), so scikit-image's random_walker adds the conjugate gradients' products in another order; NUMPY-2.4-SCALAR: numpy 2.4 onwards (2.5.4 here) raises TypeError when an array of one element with ndim > 0 is converted to a scalar ('only 0-dimensional arrays can be converted to Python scalars'; NUMPY-2.5-WRITEBACK-TEXT: numpy 2.5 words the warning it gives when a WRITEBACKIFCOPY copy is freed unresolved 'WRITEBACKIFCOPY detected in clearing of array.' (numpy/_core/src/multiarray/arrayobject.c, _clear_array_attributes); SCIPY-1.16-SCI-17: SciPy 1.16.1 onwards (gh-23293) runs the n-dimensional filter for a 1-D input shorter than half the footprint, where 1.15.3's running rank returned zeros before writing (SCI-17, fixed upstream); SCIPY-1.18-SCI-24: SciPy 1.15.3's running rank returns with a Python error set for an unknown type number (numpy's longlong) and a cval its type cannot take, which CPython turns into a SystemError (SCI-24, fixed in 1.18.1, whose TypeError larmorx gives in both) (sdcflows_scripts.CHANGES, with their sources). The workflow scripts carry no step: their originals (sdcflows 2.17.1, niworkflows, nipype) are the same in both environments, and the libraries' step under them is the library scripts'.

examples.title: SciPy's watershed corrected by default: sdcflows' epi_mask on ds003592's BOLD reference
examples.summary: sdcflows' `epi_mask` (`utils/epimanip.py`; no workflow of sdcflows or fMRIPrep calls it) masks an EPI by grey-level morphology and SciPy's `watershed_ift` from two markers, the object at the window's centre of mass and the background at one corner voxel. SciPy's watershed lets a region's front reach across the image's edges (SCI-13) and can leave an element alone in its queue (SCI-14): on this multi-echo BOLD reference the object's region stops early. LARMORX corrects both by default (rule A, measured against fMRIPrep's own brain masks) and gives SciPy's result in its reproduce mode.
